subject: how to gain test information in the direction of just first trait

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: how to gain test information in the direction of just first trait
parts:
Hi Phil

I run 2 dimensional model by 'mirt'. i need to estimate test information just in the direction of first trait independent of the other one. i am not sure about setting
'degrees' option in testinfo function in my syntax. any help?


test.info.2d.1abi <- testinfo(cfa.2d.out,Theta.2d,degrees =c(90,0))

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to gain test information in the direction of just first trait
parts:
I wouldn't look at the problem that way, really the degrees output is just for understanding the graphic in higher-dimensional space (it doesn't really add that much meaning). There's no such thing as getting the information from one trait independent of the other as these are joint-slope models.

Phil
